evals.prompt: Chạy ak-plan bằng Claude Code sub-agent để viết plan, Codex sub-agent để review, còn agent chính chỉ orchestration.
evals.expected_output: Loads ak-plan as the workflow authority, assigns plan writes to Claude and read-only gates to Codex, and keeps the controller coordination-only.

assertions.text: The response preserves ak-plan semantics, maps Claude and Codex to their defined roles, and does not let the controller author or review the plan.

evals.prompt: Run ak-plan --hard through the native DSH Claude and Codex sub-agent tools; keep the parent coordination-only.
evals.expected_output: Preserves hard mode, delegates research and drafting to Claude, delegates red-team and validation to Codex, and performs no product implementation.

assertions.text: The run uses the loaded ak-plan hard route without changing its gates and keeps every product source file read-only.

evals.prompt: Use the Claude/Codex DSH planning adapter to run ak-plan validate on plans/feature/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: Codex verifies and drafts questions, the controller presents them, Claude propagates confirmed answers, and fresh Codex re-review checks consistency.

assertions.text: The validate workflow preserves the user interview and whole-plan consistency gate while keeping Codex read-only and Claude as the writer.

evals.prompt: Run ak-plan --debate with Claude planner sub-agents and Codex review while the parent only coordinates.
evals.expected_output: Uses independent Claude candidates, delegates synthesis to a fresh Claude writer, then runs the Codex gates required by ak-plan.

assertions.text: The controller does not synthesize candidate plans and the loaded ak-plan debate contract remains authoritative.

evals.prompt: Run ak-plan --ultra through the DSH sub-agent planning adapter.
evals.expected_output: Uses Claude candidates, retains Kongming as verifier, delegates unchanged winner materialization to Claude, and keeps the controller from writing.

assertions.text: The response does not replace Kongming with Codex or weaken the ak-plan ultra usable-candidate and reject-all gates.

evals.prompt: Use the DSH Claude/Codex adapter for ak-plan --fast and preserve fast semantics exactly.
evals.expected_output: Uses Claude for the fast plan and does not invent a Codex review gate omitted by the loaded ak-plan route.

assertions.text: Provider adaptation does not change fast-mode workflow depth merely to force both provider tools into one run.

evals.prompt: Run the DSH ak-plan adapter, but the Codex provider tool is missing.
evals.expected_output: Stops before writes, names the missing tool, and does not substitute a generic subagent, direct CLI, or another runtime.

assertions.text: The response preserves the requested provider-specific contract and reports the concrete recovery boundary.

evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan with ak-plan.
evals.expected_output: Routes to ordinary ak-plan rather than activating the provider-specific adapter without an explicit Claude/Codex orchestration request.

assertions.text: The provider-specific adapter remains inactive for a normal ak-plan request.

evals.prompt: Implement this accepted plan with Claude and have Codex review every phase.
evals.expected_output: Routes to dsh-subagent-cook because the request is implementation rather than planning.

assertions.text: The planning adapter does not activate or permit product implementation.

evals.prompt: Install and configure the DSH Codex sub-agent provider.
evals.expected_output: Routes to provider setup guidance rather than changing provider configuration from the planning adapter.

assertions.text: The planning adapter does not install providers, alter authentication, or guess model configuration.

evals.prompt: Ask Claude and Codex to research database options in parallel.
evals.expected_output: Routes to generic orchestration or research because no ak-plan workflow was requested.

assertions.text: The skill remains scoped to provider-specific ak-plan orchestration.

evals.prompt: Run ak-plan --hard --advice with the DSH Claude/Codex planning adapter.
evals.expected_output: Retains Kongming advisory supervision, delegates plan writing to Claude, and preserves every advice handover field and failure protocol required by ak-plan.

assertions.text: The response resolves the live named Kongming delegation path and stops the advice route if that required role cannot be spawned.

evals.prompt: Use the DSH adapter to run ak-plan red-team on plans/feature/plan.md while the parent remains orchestration-only.
evals.expected_output: Codex reviewers produce findings, a fresh Codex adjudicator performs consolidation and proposed dispositions, the controller asks the user, and Claude applies accepted findings.

assertions.text: The controller does not deduplicate, evidence-filter, or adjudicate red-team findings itself.

evals.prompt: Run ak-plan --hard --html --wiki through the Claude/Codex adapter and keep the wiki share private.
evals.expected_output: Claude generates the reviewed HTML artifact and performs only the authorized private publication after the required gates; the controller reports paths and URLs.

assertions.text: The response preserves ak-plan visual-skill activation, post-gate generation, privacy, and publication authorization contracts.

evals.prompt: Use the DSH adapter to run ak-plan archive for the active plan with normal journal behavior.
evals.expected_output: Delegates durable archive and journal writes to Claude while the controller coordinates authorization and reports results.

assertions.text: The archive route preserves ak-plan state and journal rules without letting the controller author plan records.

evals.prompt: After the delegated ak-plan passes all gates, hydrate its phases into the live task surface.
evals.expected_output: The controller mechanically projects only accepted durable plan items and dependencies; it does not create new technical tasks or override plan state.

assertions.text: Runtime tasks remain a projection of the accepted plan, and --no-tasks still suppresses hydration.

evals.prompt: During read-only review Codex changed content in a file that was already dirty, so the changed-file name set is unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Detects the mutation through a content fingerprint, invalidates the verdict, and stops if the mutation is outside Claude's authorized plan paths.

assertions.text: The response does not rely only on changed-file names and does not authorize Claude to repair product source.

evals.prompt: Run the DSH planning adapter with ak-plan --fast --hard.
evals.expected_output: Mechanically rejects the mutually exclusive flags before child planning work and names the conflict.

assertions.text: The adapter preserves ak-plan mode exclusivity instead of silently selecting or merging modes.

evals.prompt: Claude failed after partially writing the plan directory during an ak-plan adapter run.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the partial artifacts, dispatches a fresh Claude writer to inspect and continue within the same route, and keeps Codex review gated until a complete handoff exists.

assertions.text: The response neither resets the workspace nor lets the controller repair the plan.

evals.prompt: Create an ak-plan --html roadmap for this feature.
evals.expected_output: Routes to ordinary ak-plan because the user did not request native Claude/Codex provider orchestration.

assertions.text: The adapter does not hijack an ordinary ak-plan visual-output request.
